Name: Animated Parrot and Perch
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Did you ever feel jealous of Emily for her pet parrot? Fancy yourself an amateur Psittacologist? Just like birds?

This mod adds three craftable parrot perches to the game:

[list]
[*][b]Stone Parrot Perch[/b] - costs 20 stone to build, this is the one that Emily's Parrot sits on.
[*][b]Wooden Parrot Perch[/b] - costs 20 wood to build, this is from somewhere on Ginger Island I think.
[*][b]Jungle Parrot Perch[/b] - costs 20 wood and 20 fiber to build, this is from the Ginger Island farm house parrot.
[/list]

Placing a perch adds an animated, audible parrot to the perch.

You can click on the perch to make them talk, and even feed them seeds.

Feeding seeds to the parrot may grant a random fertilizer, or treasure if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7739]Advanced Loot Framework[/url]﻿ installed.

Removing the perch removes the parrot.
